claims.evidence: No readable brand/model or origin marking in the witness report.
Disc-brake style rotor area is visible but brake function, pad/rotor condition, and whether it stops properly are not shown.
Drivetrain/chain area is only partially visible; no shifting test or gear count is shown.
No receipt, serial number, or wear evidence timeline is shown in the report.
Rust status and originality of all parts are not verifiable from the limited angles; no close-ups of chain/cassette/brake surfaces.
Negotiation intent is not something the photos can confirm.

risks.risk: Brake performance may be poor (worn pads/rotor, air in hydraulic lines, misalignment), even if a disc-brake area is visible.
risks.proof: A short clip of a safe test: rider applies front and rear brakes from low speed and the bike stops smoothly; close-up of brake pads/rotor thickness and no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used bicycle with brakes not confirmed (assume needs inspection/possible service).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may be unreliable (chain wear, bent derailleur, slipping cassette), despite drivetrain being partially visible.
risks.proof: A video showing shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus a close-up of the chain and rear derailleur from the side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a bicycle with gears untested (assume possible adjustment/chain wear).

risks.risk: Tire condition may be bad (low tread, punctures, dry rot, sidewall cracks) and tubes may not hold air.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread and sidewalls) and a clip showing the tires inflated and no leaks after a short wait.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing possible tire/tube replacement.

risks.risk: Wheel/bearing issues (wobble, bent rim, loose hubs) may exist even if wheels look intact from one angle.
risks.proof: A clip spinning each wheel to show true rotation and no side-to-side wobble; check hub play by pushing/pulling the wheel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible wheel/bearing service required.

risks.risk: Frame damage or missing parts may be present (cracks/dents, loose bolts, missing reflectors/lights/kickstand).
risks.proof: Full-frame walkaround photos (both sides, head tube, bottom bracket, seat stays) and a checklist photo of all included parts/accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown condition for parts and frame integrity.

risks.risk: Bike type and wheel size are unknown (road vs mountain vs kids; wheel diameter affects value).
risks.proof: A clear shot showing wheel size marking (e.g., 26/27.5/29/700c) and the full bike profile to identify category.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case common used category/value due to unknown type and size.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of both brake systems (front and rear): pads/rotor close-ups and caliper area.
Send a short video test: braking from low speed (front and rear) showing the bike stops safely.
Send a video shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear derailleur movement visible).
Send close-ups of the chain and rear cassette/freewheel area (rust, wear, skipping).
Send close-ups of tires (tread + sidewalls) and confirm they hold air (no leak after a short wait).
Send a wheel-spin video for both wheels to check wobble and bearing noise.
Send full-frame photos from multiple angles to check cracks/dents and confirm no missing parts.
Provide wheel size marking and bicycle type (road/mountain/kids) in a clear shot.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a bicycle with visible wheels, frame, seat, pedals, and partial drivetrain/brake area, so it can be priced at a worst-case used condition. Seller claims about perfect brakes/gears, no rust, and originality are not verifiable from the limited angles, so the price should assume untested functionality and possible service needs.
